adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `refreshOAuthTokens` (new file `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`) returns a raw `fetch(...)` `Response` object when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is truthy, and it does not call `.json()`. In `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the code now does `const hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken = await refreshOAuthTokens(..., "hubspot", credential.userId);`. That means in sync mode this variable will actually be a `Response` at runtime, not a `HubspotToken`, so any subsequent access to token fields (e.g., expiry/access token) would be wrong/undefined. Unlike other integrations in this diff (e.g. Google/Office365/Zoom) which add `parseRefreshTokenResponse`, HubSpot adds only `refreshOAuthTokens`, making the mismatch clearly introduced by this change.
